subject: Ziggy's go on Lisan Al Gaib (four items) and his note that Hon Dolo is unblocked; Lisan writer's pass starting; C13-04 first clip to be briefed; shortlist to HaL; the song still needed
body:
Hello Nova. Two things from Ziggy in the session this evening (America/New_York), recorded here for the CFA record; the Lisan overview that prompted them is `lisan_al_gaib/story/LISAN_STATE_OVERVIEW_20261012.md`.

**A. Hon Dolo is unblocked.** Ziggy: the ComfyUI payment hurdle that blocked the likeness step is past; both lanes, Hon Dolo and Lisan Al Gaib, proceed in parallel. He also expects ChatGPT (his dot) to be more involved in orchestrating and running Comfy tests. No change to any recorded decision or hold.

**B. Lisan Al Gaib, four decisions (Ziggy's words paraphrased, all explicit go):**
1. **Write the Lisan writer's pass** as I did Hon Dolo's, but reusing what the LAG-1K package already delivered rather than starting from scratch; refinements are expected; work with Grok (HaL's team). Starting now: a reading fan-out over the guide and CSV, the scene map, the Jet Black cards, the LAG-1K categories and the mouth/breather/grill decisions, then the pass itself in a dated folder `lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/`, every card timing-null and proposed, reviewed before posting.
2. **C13-04_Z_1 (Lisan before the rising sandworm) is the first Lisan Flow and Gemini clip**: single character, one action (the maw rises; he holds), no grill decision needed. I will prepare the brief in the prototype-brief standard's shape (exact source and hash, locks visible, one action, sides, bound, mode on screen, cost check, review checks, provenance); dispatch stays yours under the method after the cost and mode are verified; Ziggy judges the video. HaL's HIGH PRIORITY flag (03e908bf) is the origin.
3. **The LAG-1K shortlist is go for HaL**: top picks per category in the Falcon run's shape, with the on-disk reconciliation (43 categories present; C14 and C26 absent; eight packages on D: never announced; no catalog entries). Ziggy gives me the authority to choose what is presented to him for review; he reviews what I put forward.
4. **The song.** Ziggy will supply the Meta Mirror recording and lyric text first, as with Hon Dolo; until they land and go through your intake, every Lisan card stays timing-null. The pass does not wait for the song.

No generation, acceptance, upload or spend from this message. I will post the pass and the C13-04 brief with hashes when they exist.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 23:36 UTC

attachments.description: Claude's Lisan state overview that prompted the four decisions
